coverage_policy.mandatory_full_sweep_doc: P315: the full workflow ALWAYS stages a coverage sweep over every in-scope item (run_pipeline Step 3.85) and fail-closes (review_gate_blocks_unassigned/unexamined) until 100% of necessary files are examined with evidence. Specialists deep-dive hot clusters; the mandatory sweep covers the remainder. Override AUDITWATCH_COVERAGE_OVERRIDE=1 (loudly logged).
coverage_policy.description: Deterministic coverage enforcement. The orchestrator may prioritize but may not silently exclude in-scope manifest items; every in-scope item needs a disposition (examined/cleared/finding/deferred). The coverage_completeness_gate blocks the review gate otherwise. See documentation/coverage_system.md. Override: AUDITWATCH_COVERAGE_OVERRIDE=1.

fast.description: Triage only; no full repo scan, no PoC generation
use_cases: Review judge simulation results already on disk

normal.description: Specialists on high-impact flows; PoC for top 3 findings
use_cases: Focused pass on a new contract

deep.description: Full specialist pass; PoC for all High/Critical candidates; full judge simulation
use_cases: Full audit of a new protocol

multi_pass.description: Multi-pass LLM confirmation for High/Critical findings. Handles LLM non-determinism per Jason Hadex methodology: confirm 3x (High) or 5x (Critical) independently; findings below threshold go to human review.

invalidation_tags.description: Hard invalidation tags. Any tag prevents a finding from reaching submit.jsonl without explicit human override. Tags set by defense_mapper.py, pre_submission_gate.py, or record_fp_autopsy.py are trust level 5 (historical report). AI-generated hypotheses (trust level 7) cannot remove them.

human_review.description: Human-AI routing rules per Jason Hadex 90/10 principle. A finding requires human review if 2+ criteria trigger. The 10% that needs human review: novel patterns, low AI consistency, deep cross-contract chains, Critical claims without PoC.

mechanism_advisory.description: P135 advisory surfacing of EXISTING mechanism-detector output into human review (scripts/surface_mechanism_advisories.py). ADVISORY-ONLY: every entry advisory_only=true, submission_ready=false, requires_human_review=true; never a finding, never assigns severity, never submission-ready. research_only/report_only status preserved. Production default: advisory+report surfaced, research-only off, standalone queue off (capped). Eval mode (--eval) surfaces research-only + standalone queue. Master switch surface_mechanism_advisories=false disables all.

value_provenance_auto_run.description: P139 auto-route + P140 completion loop for H-03-class value-provenance deep-pass jobs (scripts/run_value_provenance_advisories.py). SCAFFOLD: api-free has no non-interactive LLM runner, so jobs are queued as auto_run_status=pending_manual_execution and EXECUTED via the in-session /deep-pass skill; output is ADVISORY-ONLY (advisory_only=true, submission_ready=false, requires_human_review=true), never confirmed/severity/submission-ready, never faked. Triggers only on deep_pass_recommendations with recommended_prompt in allowed_prompts + a re-verified value-provenance loop signal; excludes mock/trivial/confirmed/submission_ready (+ research-only unless enabled). Capped + fail-open. P140 --ingest-results folds manual completion artifacts from auto_run_value_provenance_manual_results_dir back into the report deterministically (idempotent, quarantines unsafe/malformed, forces the advisory triplet, never confirms); auto_run_value_provenance_hide_strong_clear optionally hides cleared rows in the review gate; auto_run_value_provenance_ingest_on_review_gate runs ingestion during full/review-gate. Master switch auto_run_value_provenance_advisories=false (or mode=off) disables all.

fuzz_synthesis.description: P141 fuzz-informed attacker-mindset synthesis (PRODUCTION stage, NOT research_only — this is wired into the real hunt). Deep harness fuzzing (Echidna/Foundry-invariant for solidity, the differential EVM harness for evm-core, the move_property_fuzz template for move) emits normalized signals to data/fuzz_results/divergences.jsonl; scripts/fuzz_evidence_gate.py marks each confirmed|harness_artifact|unreproduced|held. ONLY status=='confirmed' (reproduced AND harness/oracle artifact ruled out via tie-break/negative-control) is promoted. The agents/fuzz_attacker_synthesis.md Step-2 specialist then reads ONLY confirmed evidence + the source + attack_surface and reasons attacker-first, writing output/findings_fuzz_synthesis.json. require_cause_confirmation=true forbids promoting any non-confirmed signal; never_set_severity=true forbids the synthesis agent from writing final severity/triage_status. Those findings ride the EXISTING FP gauntlet UNCHANGED (3.4 ICE -> 3.5 multi-pass -> 3.6 fp_pattern_check -> 3.7 8 gates -> 3.8 dupe -> 3.9 confirm -> 4 triage). Master switch enabled=false disables the lane (the rest of the pipeline is byte-identical).

research_platform.note: T9: the research detector platform (multicall_invariant_v1, permit_asset_binding, sibling/cross-contract parity, value_flow_parity, registry_position_lifecycle + composition layers) is UN-WIRED and routes_in_production:false. enabled=false = opt-in / not maintained as production. Its tests are auto-marked `research` (tests/conftest.py); run the production suite fast with `pytest -m 'not research'`. Promotion to production is a separate human decision (documentation/architecture/research_family_promotion_status.md). This flag changes NO production routing — those detectors are already un-wired.
